name: Netart
summary: Cloud hosting provider (NetArt Group) with CloudHosting plans that include a CDN, PHP, Node.js and several database engines, plus domains, business email, VPS, backup and SSL services.
best_for: businesses and developers who want managed cloud hosting with a built-in CDN, PHP and Node.js, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis on one platform, room to grow storage to 10 TB, and 24/7 support
skip_if: you want the lowest possible renewal price for a small site, you need backup included in the base price, or you want a published money-back guarantee before you commit
honest_knock: The headline offers are first-period promotions; after them you pay the standard $18.75, $37.50 or $75 a month, which is more than many budget hosts charge on renewal. Backup, a dedicated IP and extra storage are paid add-ons. The price list and hosting pages we read do not describe a refund window or money-back guarantee for US customers, and changing the billing period goes through support. Netart is a large catalogue (domains, mail, VPS, SaaS, backup), so finding the right product takes reading.

pricing.entry_price_terms: CloudHosting Start · standard monthly price, net (VAT added where it applies)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-25 on netart.com/us/pricing/pricing-cloudhosting/ and on netart.com/us/hosting/) Netart sells a broad range of cloud services; this review covers CloudHosting, its main web hosting line. The standard price list is CloudHosting Start $18.75 a month, Business $37.50 and Pro $75, with 100 GB, 500 GB and 1 TB of storage. The first billing period is discounted: the Superdeal table shows the first 3 months of all three plans at $0, and the Promotion table shows Start at $0 for a first month or quarter or $112.50 for a first year, Business at $0, $112.50 or $225, and Pro at $0, $225 or $450. Both tables say the offer applies to the first billing period only, so renewals are at the standard price. Services are billed monthly, quarterly or annually, in advance for the whole period, and the page says VAT is added to the net prices. Many options cost extra, for example Data Backup from $3.75 a month for 100 GB, a dedicated geo-located IP address $5 a month, extra storage from $6.25 a month for 100 GB and 2FA for email $5 a month; the CDN and WebP image conversion are $0.

compare_with.name: Hostinger
compare_with.why: Hostinger is in our dossiers and lives on Office Software Marketplace: Premium was $2.99 a month on a 48-month prepaid term ($143.52 upfront) and renews at $10.99 when we re-read it on 9 October 2026. Netart CloudHosting Start is $18.75 a month at the standard rate with a discounted first period and 100 GB of storage (read 25 October 2026). Hostinger fits a small site that will prepay years ahead; Netart fits a business site that wants more storage, more database choice and monthly or quarterly billing.
